name: secret-sweep
description: Blocks commits that contain secrets, highlights API keys and wallet keys as you type, and scans whole GitHub accounts.

commands.title: Block commits with secrets in this repo
Block commits with secrets in every repo on this machine
Remove commit protection from this repo
Scan a GitHub user, org, or repo

secretSweep.pythonPath.description: Python 3.9+ executable. Empty means `python` on Windows and `python3` elsewhere.

secretSweep.toolPath.description: Path to secret-sweep's run.py. Empty means the copy bundled with this extension.

secretSweep.highlightSecrets.description: Underline secrets in open files as you type.

secretSweep.offerHookInstall.description: Offer to install the pre-commit hook when a repo without it is opened.
